scope: Focused CUDA recurrent regression on DGX Spark GB10; synthetic one-layer Qwen3.5 fixture, not real-model or hosted serving qualification.

result.note: Includes imported test_0 declaration tests. No allocator leaks reported.

assertions: Null-context hiddenForward and forward succeed under CUDA device-only policy.
Repeated uncached logits match and remain finite and nonzero.
Uncached logits match a fresh cached forward.
Temporary state releases its admission lease after success.
Insufficient temporary-state admission returns ResourceLimitExceeded without host download or retained lease.
